title: Powered by the Apocalypse (PbtA) Action AST

moves.name: Defy Danger
moves.description: Act despite an imminent threat or push through a dangerous situation.

moves.name: Hack and Slash
moves.description: Attack an enemy in close melee combat.

moves.name: Volley
moves.description: Attack an enemy at range with a thrown or fired weapon.

moves.name: Defend
moves.description: Stand guard over a person, item or place to protect it from harm.

moves.name: Spout Lore
moves.description: Recall what you know about a person, place, creature or thing.

moves.name: Discern Realities
moves.description: Closely study a situation or person to learn what is really going on.

moves.name: Parley
moves.description: Use leverage to get someone to do what you want through talk.

moves.name: Aid or Interfere
moves.description: Help or hinder another character who is making a move.
